decisions.reason: As an SMS-based extension of the firm's secure communication platform, it fits closely with existing cloud, integration and compliance capabilities, and its continued standalone presence from 2023 to 2024 suggests enough traction and learning potential to justify further development.

This gateway directly recombines two channels the firm already manages, so absorptive capacity is high and the firm can use its in-house R&D and enterprise integration know-how to refine and commercialise it efficiently.

Because it is closely related to the firm's established messaging and email infrastructure, the firm is well positioned to interpret early market feedback, improve the product, and offer it as part of a broader secure workflow suite.
